name: Payment Instrument 17
definition: Instrument used to process a payment instruction.

SettlementCurrency.name: Settlement Currency
SettlementCurrency.definition: Currency associated with the payment instrument.

DividendPercentage.name: Dividend Percentage
DividendPercentage.definition: Percentage of the dividend payment not to be reinvested, that is, to be paid in cash.

SubscriptionPaymentInstrument.name: Subscription Payment Instrument
SubscriptionPaymentInstrument.definition: Instrument that has or represents monetary value and is used to process a payment instruction for a subscription payment.

RedemptionPaymentInstrument.name: Redemption Payment Instrument
RedemptionPaymentInstrument.definition: Instrument that has or represents monetary value and is used to process a payment instruction for a redemption payment.

DividendPaymentInstrument.name: Dividend Payment Instrument
DividendPaymentInstrument.definition: Instrument that has or represents monetary value and is used to process a payment instruction for a dividend payment.

SavingsPlanPaymentInstrument.name: Savings Plan Payment Instrument
SavingsPlanPaymentInstrument.definition: Instrument that has or represents monetary value and is used to process a payment instruction for a savings plan payment.

InterestPaymentInstrument.name: Interest Payment Instrument
InterestPaymentInstrument.definition: Instrument that has or represents monetary value and is used to process a payment instruction for an interest payment.
